en.title: Our Paper Receives Acceptance from Physics in Medicine & Biology!
en.bodyHtml: The manuscript “Self-Cascade Latent Schrödinger Bridge for CT Field-of-View Extension,” authored by Xihao Wu, Jiacheng Liu, Haijun Yu, Andreas Maier, and Yixing Huang, has been accepted by Physics in Medicine & Biology. The study introduces a self-cascade latent Schrödinger bridge (SCL-SB) that combines a two-round shared-weight cascade with a frequency-aware residual mechanism to recover missing peripheral anatomy in truncated CT images while maintaining efficient inference. Congratulations to all the authors!

zh.title: 我组论文获《Physics in Medicine & Biology》接收！
zh.bodyHtml: 近日，Xihao Wu、Jiacheng Liu、Haijun Yu、Andreas Maier 和 Yixing Huang 合作完成的论文《Self-Cascade Latent Schrödinger Bridge for CT Field-of-View Extension》获《Physics in Medicine & Biology》接收。该研究提出自级联潜空间薛定谔桥（SCL-SB），结合共享权重的两轮自级联机制与频率感知残差机制，用于恢复截断 CT 中缺失的外周解剖结构，并兼顾解剖细节恢复与推理效率。热烈祝贺各位作者！

en.title: Welcome PhD Student Ao Wang to Our Team!
en.bodyHtml: We are delighted to announce that Ao Wang has officially joined our group as a PhD student on September 1st, 2026. Ao received his master’s degree in Instrument Science and Technology from Chongqing University, and his research will focus on CT reconstruction algorithms. We believe his expertise will further strengthen our efforts in advancing cutting-edge medical imaging technologies. We look forward to his contributions and wish him great success in his doctoral studies!

zh.title: 欢迎博士新生王奥加入我们课题组！
zh.bodyHtml: 我们很高兴地宣布，王奥于 2026 年 9 月 1 日正式加入我们课题组，成为一名博士研究生。王奥硕士毕业于重庆大学仪器科学与技术专业，研究方向为 CT 重建算法。我们相信他的加入将进一步推动我们在前沿医学成像技术方面的探索，期待他的贡献，并祝愿他在博士阶段取得丰硕成果！

en.title: Welcome PhD Student Zuodong Zhong to Our Team!
en.bodyHtml: We are delighted to announce that Zuodong Zhong officially joined our group as a PhD student in September 2026. He received his bachelor’s degree from the School of Automation at the University of Science and Technology Beijing. His research interests include long-form medical video understanding and efficient architectures for multimodal large models. We look forward to his contributions and wish him great success in his doctoral studies!

zh.title: 欢迎博士新生钟祚栋加入我们课题组！
zh.bodyHtml: 我们很高兴地宣布，钟祚栋同学于2026年9月正式加入我们的课题组，攻读博士学位。钟祚栋本科毕业于北京科技大学自动化学院，他的研究方向主要包括医学长视频理解与高效多模态大模型架构。期待他为课题组带来新的探索与贡献，并祝愿他在博士阶段取得丰硕成果！

en.title: Welcome Master Student Jiachen Tang to Our Team!
en.bodyHtml: We are pleased to welcome Tang Jiachen, who has officially joined our group as a master’s student on September 1st, 2026. She completed her bachelor’s degree at School of Computer Science, Beijing Institute of Technology. During her undergraduate studies, she co-authored a paper on explainable medical image analysis as a co-first author, which was accepted to MICCAI 2025, a top-tier conference in medical imaging, and published. The paper also received a conference award. Her current research will focus on the application of quantum computing combined with artificial intelligence in medical imaging, an emerging and interdisciplinary frontier with great potential. We look forward to her innovative contributions and wish her a fruitful and rewarding graduate journey!

zh.title: 欢迎硕士新生唐佳晨加入我们课题组！
zh.bodyHtml: 我们很高兴地宣布，唐佳晨于2026年9月1日正式加入本课题组，成为一名硕士研究生。她本科毕业于北京理工大学计算机学院。本科期间，她以共同一作身份发表了一篇可解释性医学影像分析论文，该论文被医学图像领域顶会MICCAI 2025接收并荣获会议奖项。她目前的研究方向为量子计算结合人工智能的医学影像应用，一个有潜力的新兴交叉学科前沿方向。我们期待她的创新性研究，并祝愿她在研究生阶段收获丰硕、前程似锦！

en.title: The College of Engineering at Peking University held its 2026 Opening Ceremony and Military Training Kick-off Ceremony
en.bodyHtml: Dr. Huang Yixing was invited to attend the ceremony and delivered a speech as an alumnus representative of the College of Engineering. In his remarks, he reflected on his time as a member of the inaugural undergraduate cohort in Biomedical Engineering, recalling formative experiences such as small-class intensive teaching, an interdisciplinary curriculum, mentorship in undergraduate research, and summer overseas exchange programs. He expressed his gratitude to the School for its meticulous cultivation of students. Drawing on his personal journey, he also shared practical advice with the incoming students on planning their academic paths.

en.title: Graph-Guided 3D Gaussian Framework Published in IEEE Transactions on Computational Imaging
en.bodyHtml: Our graph-guided 3D Gaussian framework, featuring denoised initialization and pixel-graph-aware densification to suppress sparse-view artifacts in cone-beam CT reconstruction, has been successfully published in IEEE Transactions on Computational Imaging.

zh.title: 图引导三维高斯框架研究发表于 IEEE Transactions on Computational Imaging
zh.bodyHtml: 我们的图引导三维高斯框架研究已发表于 IEEE Transactions on Computational Imaging。该框架采用去噪初始化与像素图感知的致密化策略，用于抑制锥束 CT 重建中的稀疏视角伪影。

en.title: Advanced Medical Artificial Intelligence Receives Graduate Course Development Funding
en.bodyHtml: The graduate course “Advanced Medical Artificial Intelligence,” led by Professor Huang Yixing, has successfully received funding from Peking University’s 2025 Graduate Course Development Initiative! The funding amount for each course is 20,000 RMB. In the fall of 2025, the “Advanced Medical Artificial Intelligence” course attracted 178 students from various departments and affiliated hospitals of Peking University Health Science Center in its first offering, far exceeding expectations. The course quality has been highly praised by both faculty and students. Special thanks to every lecturers for their tremendous support!

zh.bodyHtml: 黄益星老师负责的《高级医学人工智能》研究生课程成功获得2025年北京大学研究生课程建设资助立项！课程资助额度为每门课2万元。2025年秋季，《高级医学人工智能》课程首次开课即吸引了来自北大医学部各院系及附属医院的178名学生选修，规模远超预期，课程质量获得师生高度评价。在此特别感谢每位授课教师的大力支持！

en.title: Zuodong Zhong Receives the 2025 Baosteel Outstanding Student Award
en.bodyHtml: Congratulations to Zuodong Zhong on receiving the 2025 Baosteel Outstanding Student Award! Established in 1990 by Baosteel and administered under China’s Ministry of Education, the Baosteel Education Award is one of the most prestigious nationwide education honors in China, covering more than 120 universities across 31 provinces and recognizing roughly 500 outstanding students nationwide each year. At the University of Science and Technology Beijing (USTB), the award is selected university-wide across all majors and grade levels, with only two undergraduate recipients granted annually — making it one of USTB’s most competitive student honors. Zuodong is a senior undergraduate majoring in Automation at USTB’s School of Automation and Electrical Engineering, and will join our group for his graduate studies. The award has been officially featured by USTB’s WeChat public account: https://mp.weixin.qq.com/s/BIi0fDSpUGNLGTRJJCXMlg. We warmly congratulate Zuodong on this remarkable recognition and look forward to welcoming him to the lab.

zh.title: 祝贺钟祚栋同学荣获 2025 年度宝钢优秀学生奖！
zh.bodyHtml: 祝贺钟祚栋同学荣获 2025 年度宝钢优秀学生奖！宝钢教育奖由宝钢于 1990 年出资设立，由教育部主管，是全国最具知名度的教育奖项之一，覆盖全国 31 个省区 120 余所高校，每年在全国范围内评选约 500 名优秀学生。在北京科技大学，该奖项面向全校所有专业、所有年级评选，每年仅有 2 名本科生获奖，是学校最具分量的本科生荣誉之一。钟祚栋是北京科技大学自动化学院自动化专业的大四本科生，即将加入本课题组开展研究生阶段的学习。学校官方微信公众号已对此进行报道：https://mp.weixin.qq.com/s/BIi0fDSpUGNLGTRJJCXMlg。我们向钟祚栋同学取得的优异成绩表示热烈祝贺，并期待他加入课题组后取得更加出色的研究成果。

en.title: Hongrun Dong Completes His Master’s Thesis and Joins United Imaging Healthcare
en.bodyHtml: Congratulations to Hongrun Dong on completing his master’s thesis and starting a new position at United Imaging Healthcare as a Clinical Application Specialist (CAS). His M.Sc. thesis is entitled “Deep Learning for Cone-Beam CT Field-of-View Extension.” The thesis was supervised by Yixing Huang, together with Florian Putz and Andreas Maier. This work focuses on projection-domain completion and outpainting for truncated CBCT projections to improve downstream reconstruction quality. Best wishes to Hongrun for a great start and continued success in his new role.

zh.title: 祝贺董洪润完成硕士论文并入职联影医疗
zh.bodyHtml: 祝贺董洪润顺利完成硕士毕业论文并入职联影医疗（United Imaging Healthcare），担任临床应用专家（CAS）。其硕士论文题为《Deep Learning for Cone-Beam CT Field-of-View Extension》，由黄益星老师指导（并与 Florian Putz、Andreas Maier 共同指导）。论文围绕锥束CT（CBCT）投影截断导致的视野受限问题，研究投影域补全与外延（projection completion/outpainting）以提升后续重建质量。祝董洪润在新岗位工作顺利、持续成长。

en.title: Welcome Dr. Meng Li to Our Team!
en.bodyHtml: We are delighted to welcome Dr. Meng Li to join our research group as a postdoctoral researcher on April 1st, 2025. Dr. Li focus on establishing multimodal MRI-based methodologies to assess brain diseases and identify potential biomarkers associated with neuropsychiatric disorders, and her research will further promote our exploration in the field of medical image analysis.

zh.title: 欢迎李萌博士加入团队
zh.bodyHtml: 我们欢迎李萌博士于2026年4月1日加入我们课题组担任博士后研究员。李博士致力于应用基于多模态磁共振成像（MRI）的方法评估脑部疾病并识别与神经精神障碍相关的潜在生物标志物。她的研究将进一步推动我们在医学图像分析方面的探索

en.title: Anqi Wang’s Master’s Thesis Research Published in the BVM Proceedings
en.bodyHtml: Congratulations to Anqi Wang’s master’s thesis study has been successully published in the German Medical Imaging Conference (BVM) proceeding. Her abstract is entitled Comparative Study of Deep Learning Models for Brain Metastases Autosegmentation. Anqi was a master student of Medical Technology, Friedrich-Alexander University Erlangen-Nuremberg, Germany. Her thesis was jointly supervised by Yixing Huang, Florian Putz and Andreas Maier. Now she is a PhD candidate in the iMRI group, Institute for Diagnostic and Interventional Radiology, Hannover Medical School. Best wishes to Anqi’s PhD life.

zh.title: 祝贺王安琪的硕士论文研究成功发表于德国医学影像会议（BVM）论文集。
zh.bodyHtml: 祝贺王安琪的硕士论文研究成功发表于德国医学影像会议（BVM）论文集。她的摘要题为《脑转移瘤自动分割深度学习模型的比较研究》。王安琪是德国埃尔朗根-纽伦堡大学医学技术硕士生。她的论文由黄益星、Florian Putz和Andreas Maier共同指导。她目前在汉诺威医学院诊断与介入放射学研究所iMRI课题组攻读博士学位。祝愿安琪的博士生涯一切顺利。
